title: Spatial interpolation of rainfall with kriging and inverse distance weighting
text: We compare ordinary kriging and inverse distance weighting (IDW) for interpolating daily rainfall from 120 gauges. Kriging with a spherical variogram reduced the root mean square error by 14 percent relative to IDW. Geostatistical interpolation benefits from spatial autocorrelation in the gauge network.

title: Large language models as autonomous GIS agents
text: Autonomous GIS uses large language models to decompose spatial questions into data retrieval, operations and outputs. A GIS copilot inside QGIS solved basic and intermediate tasks reliably, while complex multi-step workflows remained difficult. Logging and code testing were identified as missing components.

title: Network analysis of urban accessibility with OpenStreetMap
text: Isochrones computed on the OpenStreetMap road network measure accessibility to hospitals. Shortest path routing with travel time weights revealed that 18 percent of residents live beyond a 15 minute drive.

title: Moran's I for hot spot analysis of traffic accidents
text: Spatial autocorrelation of traffic accidents was measured with Moran's I and Getis-Ord hot spot analysis. Clusters concentrated along arterial roads near the city centre.

title: MNDWI for open water mapping in turbid lakes with Sentinel-2
text: The modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) uses the green and shortwave infrared (SWIR1, band 11) bands of Sentinel-2. In turbid and brackish lakes, suspended sediment raises near-infrared reflectance, which weakens NDWI, whereas SWIR remains strongly absorbed by water. MNDWI with a threshold of zero mapped water with 96 percent overall accuracy.

title: Wetland mapping at Lake Ichkeul with Landsat time series
text: Lake Ichkeul in northern Tunisia is a Ramsar wetland whose open water extent varies with rainfall and upstream dams. A Landsat time series from 1984 to 2020 shows seasonal water loss in summer and high salinity in dry years.

title: Cloud masking of Sentinel-2 with the scene classification layer
text: The Sen2Cor scene classification layer (SCL) labels clouds, cloud shadows and cirrus. Masking SCL classes 3, 8, 9 and 10 before compositing removed most cloud contamination in monthly median composites.

title: Flood mapping with Sentinel-1 SAR
text: Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar backscatter drops over open floodwater, which allows flood mapping through clouds. Otsu thresholding of VV backscatter produced flood extent maps validated against Sen1Floods11 labels.

title: Roof plane extraction from airborne LiDAR with RANSAC
text: Roof planes were extracted from airborne LiDAR point clouds with RANSAC plane fitting followed by region growing. The resulting LoD2 building models reached a median height error of 6 cm against reference data.

title: Canopy height model from GEDI and airborne laser scanning
text: A canopy height model was derived by subtracting the digital terrain model from the digital surface model of airborne laser scanning, and compared with GEDI waveform heights over temperate forest.

title: Ground filtering of point clouds with the cloth simulation filter
text: The cloth simulation filter separates ground points from vegetation and buildings in airborne LiDAR. It outperformed the progressive morphological filter on steep terrain.

title: PointNet++ for semantic segmentation of urban point clouds
text: PointNet++ was trained to segment urban point clouds into ground, building, vegetation and car classes, reaching 87 percent mean intersection over union on the DALES dataset.

title: Urban digital twin for rooftop solar potential
text: An urban digital twin combines LoD2 building models from LiDAR with solar irradiance simulation to estimate rooftop photovoltaic potential. Shadow analysis from neighbouring buildings reduced the estimated yield by 12 percent.

title: CityJSON for lightweight 3D city models
text: CityJSON encodes the CityGML data model in JSON, which makes 3D city models smaller and easier to stream to web digital twins through 3D Tiles.

title: Digital twin of a water network with IoT sensors
text: A digital twin of a drinking water network fuses IoT pressure sensors with hydraulic simulation to detect leaks within hours.

title: Flood digital twin with hydrodynamic modelling
text: A flood digital twin couples a hydrodynamic model with a digital terrain model from LiDAR to simulate inundation scenarios for a coastal city.

title: U-Net for building footprint extraction from aerial imagery
text: A U-Net convolutional neural network extracted building footprints from aerial images with an F1 score of 0.91. Data augmentation and a boundary-aware loss improved results on dense urban blocks.

title: Prithvi geospatial foundation model for flood and wetland segmentation
text: Prithvi is a geospatial foundation model pre-trained with a masked autoencoder on Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 data. Fine-tuned on Sen1Floods11 and wetland mapping tasks it outperformed a U-Net trained from scratch with fewer labels.

title: Self-supervised learning for land cover classification
text: Contrastive self-supervised pre-training on unlabeled Sentinel-2 patches improved land cover classification on EuroSAT and BigEarthNet when labels were scarce.

title: Change detection in satellite images with transformers
text: A Siamese vision transformer detected building changes between bi-temporal very high resolution images, improving F1 over convolutional baselines.
